_doc: Diễn xuất từng câu cho TTS bản EN. id: [cảm xúc, độ lệch tốc độ so với tốc độ gốc của vai, cao độ (−12…12), lời đọc riêng hoặc null]. Câu không có ở đây dùng cảm xúc và tốc độ của câu cùng mã bản VN. Mọi câu (kể cả lời đọc riêng) đều qua quy tắc ngắt nghỉ tự động trong tts_sentences.py: '...' → nghỉ 0,45 s · ' — ' → 0,15 s · ': ' trước chữ hoa → 0,3 s. Chữ trên màn hình và phụ đề không đổi.
1.03#3: On the shared Facebook page of the best-known mother and daughter in the area — Dee Dee Blanchard and her daughter Gypsy Rose, who everyone believed was severely disabled — a short, bitter status suddenly appeared, announcing that Dee Dee was dead... and the whole neighborhood fell silent.
1.08#1: But when police entered that cold, silent house that night... they found the mother — Dee Dee Blanchard — dead in her bedroom.
1.11#2: But just one day later, when officers found Gypsy Rose in Wisconsin, hundreds of miles from the scene... a truth came to light that stunned doctors and investigators alike.
1.11#4: She walked in... on her own two feet.
1.11#8: And the person behind the plan that led to the death of that saintly mother... was none other than her own little girl.
1.13#1: Welcome... to the criminal psychology case files.
2.02#3: The real crime scene... is Gypsy Rose’s body, over the 23 years that came before.
2.06#1: But Dee Dee... did not stop at lies.
2.07#2: First, she gave Gypsy high doses of anti-seizure medication... even though she had no epilepsy — drugs that, according to later reports, contributed to the loss of her teeth.
2.09#4: A prison without bars... built instead from prescriptions, IV tubes... and the glow of charity.
3.02#4: But from the perspective of criminal psychology and forensic psychiatry... money was only a side benefit.
3.05#2: The first layer... is an addiction to the glory of the martyred saint.
3.05#7: But the moment she took on the role of the brave single mother of a dying child... Dee Dee suddenly became the center of the universe.
3.08#4: How do you keep a human being by your side... forever?
3.10#1: And finally... the third layer: the psychological signature of erasing an identity.
4.03#3: So why, in all those years, in front of hundreds of doctors, police officers and crowds, did Gypsy never once stand up from that wheelchair... and expose her mother?
4.07#3: From that moment on, even when the cage door is wide open... the animal will lie still and endure, and never walk out again.
4.07#7: But to Gypsy... it was a secret threat: If she said even one wrong word, or showed that she was healthy, that grip would tighten like a silent warning.
4.10#2: But Dee Dee soon tracked her down... at a hotel.
4.15#5: And on a night in June 2015... the tragedy erupted, when Gypsy opened the door for Godejohn to walk into the pink house...
5.10#3: When love is twisted into a cage, when care becomes a tool to satisfy an adult’s selfish ego... then what wears the robe of an angel can sometimes be as devastating as any crime.
